title: Discrete-modulation continuous-variable quantum key distribution with probabilistic amplitude shaping over a linear quantum channel
summary: The practical implementation difficulties arising from the Gaussian modulation of the GG02 protocol lead us to investigate the possibilities offered by the combination of probabilistic amplitude shaping technique and quadrature amplitude modulation formats in the context of continuous variable quantum key distribution systems. Our interest comes from the fact that quadrature amplitude modulation and probabilistic shaping can be implemented with current technologies and are widely used in classical telecom equipment.
